title: MLOps: model, system, continuous improvement
summary: Machine learning in production is a three-body problem: model performance, system reliability and continuous improvement. 'Train, deploy, hope' is the two-body version; feedback loops and retraining close the loop so the model keeps getting better against real use.
source: Ch07 §7.3 — 'Model Performance / System Reliability / Continuous Improvement' (replaces the Covariant sim-to-real figure)
